name: Steady Handgrip
description: Pinch the dart shaft against the board's groove and feel its balance before lifting the pair.

name: Spurgauge
description: Press the dart's hollow butt onto the upright spur until it sits snug and does not wobble.

name: Shifting Handgrip
description: Turn the lead shoulder to the target and slide the rear foot back, opening a clear throwing line.

name: Warm Throwstick
description: Lift the loaded board back past the ear with the elbow high, so the whole arm stores the throw.

name: Extendblow
description: Whip the board forward and let the dart go at shoulder height, flying straight along a flat line.

name: Hooding Throwstick
description: After release, sweep the throwing arm down across the chest so it covers the ribs from a reply.

name: Calm Weightstone
description: Belt the quiver at the hip and rock the body once, checking that the darts ride quietly.

name: Smooth Dartshaft
description: Draw a dart out by its feathers with the thumb on the fletch, so the shaft leaves the quiver straight.

name: Backward Throwlever
description: Slide back a pace while the free hand seats a fresh dart, so loading never stops the retreat.

name: Quick Whipover
description: Cast one dart, draw the next and cast again within a single breath, both aimed at one mark.

name: Weightstone Count
description: Count the darts left in the quiver by touch alone, so the thrower always knows what remains.

name: Cupendcowl
description: Drop behind a log or rock to reload, with the board arm tucked and the head low.

name: Stepping Flexshaft
description: Walk the cast line after practice and gather every dart, noting which flew true and which veered.

name: Measured Spurhook
description: Run a thumbnail over the spur's tip to find burrs that would foul a clean release.

name: Even Atlshaft
description: Roll the dart across a flat palm until the bow in the shaft shows itself.

name: Soft Fingerhooks
description: Keep two fingers loose in the board's loops, so the hand never strangles the throw.

name: Propeldash
description: Snap only the wrist and forearm to send a quick dart a short way without winding the body.

name: Nimble Leverage
description: Turn on the rear heel right after the throw, leaving the cast spot with the body already facing away.

name: Deep Gripbinding
description: Square the hips to the target before the arm moves, so the throw begins in the legs.

name: Easing Dartshaft
description: Walk forward with the loaded board held low and the dart tip trailing behind the shoulder.

name: Kind Flexshaft
description: Raise the elbow above the shoulder and cock the board back, setting the high arc of the cast.

name: Upward Throwlever
description: Whip the board over the shoulder so the dart climbs in a high bow before dropping on its mark.

name: Descending Weightstone
description: Lob a dart at a steep angle so it falls point-first on a target behind a low barrier.

name: Angled Handgrip
description: Roll the throwing shoulder back after release and let a glancing blow slide off the arm.

name: Watching Cupend
description: Lift a wet finger to feel the crosswind and aim a hand's width into it.

name: Judging Throwstick
description: Pace out the distance to the mark and fit the height of the arc to the paces counted.

name: Cupreview
description: Tie a straw bundle to a post at chest height to serve as the day's mark.

name: Watching Dartshaft
description: Fix the eyes on one stalk of straw and keep them there through the entire cast.

name: Tending Handgrip
description: Repeat one throw a hundred times with no change of grip or stance until the arm repeats itself unthinking.

name: Sharp Dartshaft
description: Cast hard at the center of the bundle so the dart point buries to its foreshaft.

name: Single Spurhook
description: Place three darts in a tight cluster along one edge of the bundle, training a steady aim.

name: Spurhop
description: Step away from the cast line the instant the dart leaves, as though a reply were coming.

name: Gentle Cupend
description: Draw a thread of circulating qi into the gripping hand so the board feels light and answers sharply.

name: Straight Atlshaft
description: Throw with arm and a trace of qi so the dart holds a flat, steady line to the mark.

name: Spurnote
description: Trail qi-sense along the flying shaft and feel any wobble in its tail before it lands.

name: Judging Flexshaft
description: Aim ahead of a walking target by the ground it will cover while the dart is in the air.

name: Sudden Fingerhooks
description: Roll the fingers off the shaft at release, so the spinning dart flies truer over a long throw.

name: Cupdodge
description: Slide one pace sideways on qi-light feet and bring the board up already loaded.

name: Raised Flexshaft
description: Bring the board's broad flat across the body and knock an incoming dart aside.

name: Calm Spurhook
description: Feel with qi-aided touch how tightly the dart's butt must sit on the spur to release clean.

name: Spurhusk
description: Set the feet wide on wet ground and push qi down through the soles so the cast cannot skid the thrower.

name: Cupgauge
description: Flick a new dart onto the spur with a qi-quick thumb, ready before the last one lands.

name: Spurstrike
description: Snap the board forward so the spur drives the dart off its seat in one crisp, clean push.

name: Extendpace
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot across loose stones without letting the board arm drift.

name: Propelwedge
description: Throw low at the earth ahead of an advancing foe so his stride breaks.

name: Mild Fingerhooks
description: Thread the first two fingers through the board's loops and close the thumb over the shaft in one motion.

name: Steady Gripbinding
description: Hold the board with loop, thumb and heel of the hand together, spreading the pull of the throw.

name: Narrow Gripbinding
description: Twist the wrist as the fingers slip from the loops, giving the dart a clean spin off the spur.

name: Solid Gripbinding
description: Run qi into the gripping palm so a hard knock to the board does not shake the hand open.

name: Tending Throwstick
description: Roll the wrist in slow circles with qi riding the tendons until the joint moves without a catch.

name: Fingerhooks Note
description: Feel a loop slide off the finger and hook it again with a flick before the board falls.

name: Cupbump
description: Snap a short dart from the loops at a foe within arm's reach, trading force for speed.

name: Skipping Fingerhooks
description: Step back two paces while the loops are re-threaded, putting distance between thrower and a pressing foe.

name: Weightstone Gauge
description: Weigh several shafts in the hand and keep the lightest one that still flies straight.

name: Flat Extend
description: Flick a light dart off the spur with little arm, and it skims away swift and shallow.

name: Fouling Overarm
description: Send a dart past an unseen foe's ear to startle him out from behind his cover.

name: Cupendhit
description: Cast dart after dart in a steady chain, each one reloaded while the last is still flying.

name: Propeltrot
description: Circle wide around a foe on light feet and cast again from his flank.

name: Swaying Weightstone
description: Creep forward bent low with the board held close, setting each foot where dry leaves will not betray it.

name: Gentle Handgrip
description: Sweep the board back at hip height with a qi-loosened shoulder, loading the low throw.

name: Low Leverage
description: Cast the dart low along the earth so it rises only at the last moment into the target's legs.

name: Cupendreview
description: Read bent grass and scuffed earth to learn which way a quarry went and how recently.

name: Spurhit
description: Throw from beneath low boughs, flattening the arm so the board never snags the leaves.

name: Soft Spurhook
description: Hold still on the downwind side of the quarry and breathe slowly until its guard drops.

name: Settled Dartshaft
description: Swing the board's flat against a lunging beast's snout, turning the rush aside for one breath.
